intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for two. Watch the sun melt into the horizon while sipping champagne and enjoying a curated platter of local and international canapés. A quintessential romantic experience perfect for honeymooners seeking intimacy and breathtaking natural beauty.

experiences.name: Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef
experiences.description: Explore one of the Maldives' most iconic and vibrant coral reefs, teeming with parrotfish, moray eels, sea turtles, and colorful reef sharks. Guided snorkeling sessions ensure you discover the best spots while learning about the marine ecosystem. Crystal-clear visibility and calm waters make this an unforgettable underwater adventure for couples.

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' spa ritual inside a stunning glass-walled underwater treatment room, surrounded by the gentle movement of tropical fish and coral gardens. Choose from signature massages, body wraps, and aromatherapy treatments designed to rejuvenate and deepen your romantic connection in an utterly unique luxury setting.
experiences.location: Huvafen Fushi Resort, North Malé Atoll

experiences.name: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience
experiences.description: Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the ocean for an exclusive private dining setup. A personal butler and chef serve a freshly prepared Maldivian and seafood feast with chilled wine, surrounded by nothing but white sand and endless blue water — the ultimate honeymoon memory.

experiences.name: Malé Cultural Walking Tour & Local Market Visit
experiences.description: Discover the vibrant culture and heritage of the Maldivian capital with a guided walking tour through the historic streets of Malé. Visit the 17th-century Hukuru Miskiy coral stone mosque, the National Museum, and the bustling local fish market where fishermen bring in their daily catch. Sample traditional Maldivian street snacks like hedhikaa and sip on sweet black tea at a local café.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

experiences.name: Malé Cultural Walking Tour & Local Market Visit
experiences.description: Discover the vibrant culture and heritage of the Maldivian capital with a guided walking tour through the historic streets of Malé. Visit the 17th-century Hukuru Miskiy coral stone mosque, the National Museum, and the bustling local fish market where fishermen bring in their daily catch. Sample traditional Maldivian street snacks like hedhikaa and sip on sweet black tea at a local café.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled – flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 13:00. Clear immigration and collect luggage. Take a budget-friendly public ferry from the airport jetty to Malé (approx. $1 USD) and then arrange a speedboat or local ferry transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, freshen up, and explore the beachfront property. Take a slow walk along the resort beach to get oriented and enjoy your first sunset views over the Indian Ocean.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into your beachfront room. Enjoy a welcome drink at the resort's beach bar. Head to the resort's most affordable dining outlet for a relaxed first dinner. Watch the stars emerge over the ocean from the beach – a magical, free romantic experience perfect for couples and honeymooners.

meals.breakfast: Grab a snack or light meal at the airport before or after landing – airport café sandwiches or local Maldivian short eats (hedhikaa) from a kiosk (~$5–8 USD)
meals.lunch: Light bites at the airport or on the ferry transfer – pack some snacks to save money during transit
meals.dinner: Resort's casual beachside restaurant – opt for the set menu or daily special to keep costs down (~$15–25 USD per person). Look for local fish dishes like grilled tuna with rice.

day_by_day.notes: Day 1 is purely arrival and settling in. Confirm your resort transfer in advance to avoid expensive last-minute speedboat charters. Public ferry options are significantly cheaper but may take longer. Exchange some USD to MVR (Maldivian Rufiyaa) at the airport for local purchases. Budget tip: avoid the resort minibar and bring bottled water from the ferry terminal.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise beach walk along the resort's beachfront – completely free and incredibly romantic. After sunrise, enjoy the resort's included breakfast (if part of your package) or head to the nearest local island's tea shop (sai hotel) for a traditional Maldivian breakfast of mas huni (tuna and coconut) with roshi flatbread and sweet tea (~$3–5 USD). Begin your first snorkeling session at the house reef directly in front of Aegean Bliss Resort – rent basic snorkel gear from the resort (~$10–15 USD/day) or bring your own for zero cost.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue snorkeling at the house reef during the best light hours (10am–2pm) when visibility is at its peak. Look for reef sharks, sea turtles, colorful parrotfish, and vibrant coral formations. After snorkeling, relax on the beach with a book or simply soak in the romance of the surroundings. Visit the resort's water sports desk to inquire about free or low-cost activities included in your stay.
day_by_day.evening: Catch the sunset from the beach or a nearby sandbank. Enjoy a romantic beachside dinner at the resort – choose grilled fresh catch of the day, which is typically the most affordable and freshest option. After dinner, take a moonlit stroll along the shoreline and stargaze – the Maldives has minimal light pollution, making the night sky extraordinary.

meals.breakfast: Traditional Maldivian breakfast at a local tea shop on the nearest local island – mas huni, roshi, and tea (~$3–5 USD) or resort breakfast if included
meals.lunch: Pack a simple picnic from the local market or grab a light snack at the resort's beach café – fresh fruit, local short eats (~$5–8 USD)
meals.dinner: Resort beachside restaurant – grilled fish of the day with steamed rice and vegetables (~$18–25 USD per person). Share a dessert to save costs.

day_by_day.notes: The house reef is one of the best free or low-cost snorkeling spots available. Go early morning or late afternoon for the best marine life activity. Bring reef-safe sunscreen to protect the coral ecosystem. Budget tip: rent snorkel gear for the full trip duration rather than per day – ask for a weekly rate.

day_by_day.morning: Join the Malé Cultural Walking Tour & Local Market Visit – a guided tour through the Maldivian capital covering the Grand Friday Mosque (Masjid al-Sultan Muhammad Thakurufaanu Al Auzam), the National Museum, the old harbour, and the colourful local streets. This tour provides incredible cultural insight into Maldivian heritage, architecture, and daily life. Depart from the resort via public ferry to Malé (~$1–2 USD each way).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Local Market (Maalé Vegetable and Fish Market) independently after the tour. Browse fresh tuna, tropical fruits, and local produce. Visit the Malé Fish Market to witness the lively afternoon fish auction – a fascinating cultural experience at no cost. Shop for budget-friendly Maldivian souvenirs like woven mats (kunaa), lacquerware, and local spices along Chandhanee Magu street. Return to the resort via public ferry.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a quiet romantic evening at the resort. Visit the beach bar for a sundowner cocktail (budget tip: choose local beer or soft drinks over imported cocktails to save ~50%). Dine at the resort or explore a local island eatery if accessible. Reflect on the day's cultural discoveries with your partner.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or local tea shop – fresh tropical fruit plate, eggs, and Maldivian tea (~$5–8 USD)
meals.lunch: Eat like a local in Malé at a traditional short-eat café (sai hotel) – a full meal of curry, rice, and tea costs as little as $3–6 USD. Try garudhiya (tuna broth soup) or rihaakuru (tuna paste) with rice.
meals.dinner: Local island restaurant near the resort or resort's set menu dinner (~$15–22 USD per person). Look for fresh tuna curry with coconut rice.

day_by_day.notes: The Malé Cultural Walking Tour is the highlight of Day 3 – book in advance as spots may be limited. Malé is one of the world's most densely populated cities – fascinating to explore on foot. Dress modestly when visiting mosques (cover shoulders and knees). Budget tip: the public ferry between the resort island and Malé is a fraction of the cost of a private speedboat.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling session at the house reef before the day heats up. Focus on the deeper reef sections where larger marine life such as nurse sharks, eagle rays, and schools of barracuda are commonly spotted. Bring an underwater camera or use a waterproof phone case for photos. After snorkeling, rinse off and enjoy a leisurely breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrange a budget sandbank picnic excursion through the resort or a local guesthouse – a shared group boat trip to a nearby uninhabited sandbank costs significantly less than a private charter (~$20–35 USD per person shared vs. $100+ for private). Spend the afternoon on the pristine white sandbank surrounded by turquoise lagoon waters. Snorkel around the sandbank edges for excellent marine life encounters. This is an incredibly romantic and photogenic experience perfect for honeymoners.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort before sunset. Freshen up and enjoy a romantic sunset from your beachfront room or balcony. Cook up a simple meal using ingredients purchased from the Malé market yesterday (if you have access to a kitchenette) or dine at the resort. Enjoy a quiet evening stroll along the beach hand-in-hand.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or fresh tropical fruit with yogurt from the local market (~$5–8 USD)
meals.lunch: Sandbank picnic – bring packed sandwiches, fresh fruit, and water purchased from the local market the day before to significantly reduce costs. Alternatively, the boat trip may include a basic lunch (~$5 extra)
meals.dinner: Resort restaurant – fresh catch BBQ night if available, or opt for a simple pasta or rice dish (~$15–20 USD per person)

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank excursion is a quintessential Maldives experience and absolutely worth the cost. Book through the resort's activities desk or ask local guesthouse owners for cheaper shared group rates. Bring plenty of water, sunscreen, and a hat – there is zero shade on a sandbank. Budget tip: bring your own snacks and drinks to the sandbank rather than purchasing from the boat operator.

day_by_day.morning: Explore the nearest local inhabited island on foot – a wonderful way to experience authentic Maldivian village life, see traditional wooden dhoni boats being built, and interact with friendly locals. Friday is the holy day in the Maldives, so note that some businesses may be closed during midday prayers. Visit the local school, community center, and any small mosques (from the outside respectfully). This is a completely free cultural experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a relaxed afternoon. Spend time on the beach reading, sunbathing, or simply floating in the warm lagoon waters. Take a long swim in the crystal-clear shallows. Alternatively, ask the resort about free or low-cost activities such as beach volleyball, kayaking in the lagoon, or a guided reef walk during low tide.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic beach dinner – if the resort offers a special beach dining setup, inquire about the cost as some resorts offer this at a reasonable rate for honeymooners. Alternatively, lay out a blanket on the beach with snacks and drinks from the local market and stargaze together. The bioluminescent plankton phenomenon (glowing blue water) can sometimes be seen on dark beach nights – walk the shoreline after 9pm to look for it.

meals.breakfast: Local island tea shop breakfast on the inhabited island – mas huni, roshi, and tea (~$3–5 USD). A truly authentic experience.
meals.lunch: Simple resort café lunch – choose the daily special or a light salad/sandwich (~$10–15 USD). Alternatively, buy fresh fruit from the local island.
meals.dinner: Resort set dinner or a special romantic beach setup – negotiate a budget-friendly option with the resort in advance (~$20–30 USD per person)

day_by_day.notes: Friday is the Islamic holy day – dress modestly when visiting the local island and be respectful of prayer times. The bioluminescent plankton is a natural phenomenon that cannot be guaranteed but is more likely on darker nights away from artificial light. Budget tip: many local islands have small cafés where you can get incredibly cheap and delicious local food.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up for an early morning dolphin watching excursion – one of the most magical and affordable Maldives experiences. Shared group dolphin cruises depart at sunrise (~$20–30 USD per person) and offer incredible sightings of spinner dolphins leaping in the golden morning light. Book through the resort or a local operator for the best rates. Return by mid-morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon snorkeling at a different reef location – ask the resort or local boat operators about nearby reef spots that can be reached by a short dhoni ride (~$5–10 USD per person shared). Different reefs offer completely different marine ecosystems. Look for moray eels, lionfish, and vibrant nudibranch sea slugs in addition to the usual reef fish.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a relaxed resort evening. Visit the resort's spa menu and inquire about budget-friendly treatments – many resorts offer shorter 30-minute treatments at a fraction of the cost of full packages. A couples' foot massage or back rub can be a wonderfully romantic and relatively affordable indulgence (~$30–50 USD for a short treatment). Dine at the resort and enjoy live music or entertainment if available.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before the early dolphin cruise – resort breakfast or a banana and energy bar (~$5 USD)
meals.lunch: Post-snorkeling lunch at the resort beach café – fresh fish tacos or a local rice and curry plate (~$10–15 USD)
meals.dinner: Resort restaurant – try the Maldivian-style curry night if offered. Coconut fish curry with steamed rice is both authentic and affordable (~$15–22 USD per person)

day_by_day.notes: Spinner dolphins are most active at sunrise – the early start is absolutely worth it. The dolphin watching cruise is one of the most memorable experiences in the Maldives and very budget-friendly when done as a shared group excursion. Budget tip: avoid booking through the resort's premium excursion packages – instead, negotiate directly with local boat operators at the jetty for significantly lower prices.

day_by_day.morning: Mid-trip rest and relaxation day. Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely breakfast. Spend the morning floating in the lagoon, reading on the beach, or simply doing nothing – one of the greatest luxuries of a Maldives trip. Practice mindful relaxation and soak in the incredible surroundings with your partner.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's facilities at no extra cost – swimming pool, beach loungers, hammocks, and any complimentary water sports. Try stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) if available as a complimentary activity or at a low hourly rate (~$10–15 USD/hour). Paddle around the lagoon for stunning views of the resort and surrounding ocean. This is excellent gentle exercise and a unique perspective of the island.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktail hour on the beach – splurge slightly on one special cocktail each to mark the halfway point of your trip. Watch the sun melt into the Indian Ocean horizon together. Enjoy a romantic dinner at the resort, perhaps trying a different restaurant or dining venue than usual to keep the experience fresh.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely resort breakfast – indulge in the full spread if included in your package, or order eggs and fresh tropical juice (~$8–12 USD)
meals.lunch: Light beach lunch – fresh coconut (buy from a local vendor or resort beach bar), tropical fruit platter, and a cold drink (~$8–12 USD)
meals.dinner: Resort dinner – try a different cuisine option if the resort has multiple restaurants. Seafood pasta or grilled snapper with salad (~$18–25 USD per person)

day_by_day.notes: Rest days are essential on a 13-day trip – don't feel pressured to fill every moment with activities. The Maldives is equally magical when you simply sit and exist within it. Budget tip: bring a reusable water bottle and ask the resort to refill it with filtered water rather than purchasing bottled water throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget snorkeling boat trip to a nearby famous reef – many local operators run shared group trips to renowned snorkeling spots such as coral gardens, manta ray cleaning stations, or shark nurseries (~$25–40 USD per person shared). These trips typically include 2–3 snorkeling stops and offer dramatically different marine environments than the house reef. Depart early to beat the heat.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from the boat trip by early afternoon. Rinse gear and relax on the beach. Use the afternoon to write postcards or a travel journal entry, capturing memories of the trip so far. Visit the resort's gift shop to browse for small souvenirs – compare prices with what you saw in Malé's local market.
day_by_day.evening: Cooking or cultural experience – inquire with the resort about any local cooking classes or cultural demonstrations (some resorts offer these free or at low cost). Learn to make traditional Maldivian dishes like garudhiya soup or coconut sambol. Alternatively, watch a traditional Bodu Beru drumming performance if the resort or a nearby island hosts one.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the boat trip – toast, fruit, and coffee (~$5–8 USD)
meals.lunch: On-boat lunch – bring packed sandwiches and snacks, or the tour operator may include a simple meal (~$5–8 USD extra if not included)
meals.dinner: Resort restaurant or local island eatery – celebrate the day's incredible snorkeling with a fresh seafood dinner. Grilled lobster or crab (split one between two people to save costs) with rice (~$25–35 USD shared)

day_by_day.notes: Always confirm what is included in a boat snorkeling trip before booking – some operators include equipment, lunch, and water while others charge extra for each. Shared group trips are dramatically cheaper than private charters. Budget tip: form a group with other resort guests to negotiate even lower per-person rates for boat excursions.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning beach yoga or meditation session – find a quiet spot on the beach at sunrise for a free, deeply peaceful experience. The sound of gentle waves and the warm morning light make for an incredibly romantic and rejuvenating start to the day. Follow with a swim in the calm morning lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a DIY island hopping trip using public ferries to visit 2–3 nearby local islands. This is one of the most budget-friendly ways to explore the Maldives beyond your resort island. Each public ferry ride costs as little as $1–3 USD. Explore different island communities, visit local mosques and cemeteries, and observe the contrast between tourist resort islands and authentic Maldivian village life.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Enjoy a sundowner on the beach. This evening, splurge slightly on a special romantic dinner – request a table in the most scenic location at the resort restaurant (beachfront, overwater, or garden setting). This is your mid-trip romantic highlight dinner.

meals.breakfast: Fresh fruit smoothie bowl and toast at the resort (~$8–10 USD) or a light local breakfast on one of the islands you visit
meals.lunch: Eat at a local island café during your island hopping adventure – authentic Maldivian rice and curry lunch for as little as $3–5 USD per person. This is the best value food experience in the Maldives.
meals.dinner: Special romantic resort dinner – choose a set menu or the chef's recommendation. Fresh grilled tuna steak or red snapper with tropical sides (~$25–35 USD per person). Share a dessert to keep costs manageable.

day_by_day.notes: Public ferry schedules between local islands are not always frequent – check timetables in advance at the resort's front desk or with local ferry operators. Some islands may require modest dress (cover shoulders and knees). Budget tip: public ferry island hopping is hands down the most authentic and cheapest way to explore multiple Maldivian islands.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicated underwater photography morning at the house reef. Borrow or rent an underwater camera housing, or use a waterproof phone case. Spend 2 hours methodically photographing coral formations, reef fish, and any larger marine life. This creative activity adds depth to your snorkeling experience and gives you lasting memories to take home.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local island's community center or artisan workshop to observe traditional Maldivian crafts – lacquerware (liyelaa jehun), mat weaving (kunaa), and boat building (dhoni construction). These are often free to observe and provide wonderful cultural insight. Purchase one or two handmade items directly from local artisans as meaningful, budget-friendly souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic beach bonfire evening – inquire with the resort about arranging a small beach bonfire (~$15–25 USD setup fee, if available). Sit together by the fire, listening to the ocean waves, under a sky full of stars. This is one of the most romantic and memorable experiences possible in the Maldives at a very reasonable cost.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast – fuel up for the morning's snorkeling session with a protein-rich breakfast (~$8–12 USD)
meals.lunch: Local island café lunch – fresh fish curry with rice and coconut sambol (~$4–6 USD per person). Incredibly authentic and delicious.
meals.dinner: Light resort dinner or takeaway from a local island – keep dinner simple to balance the week's spending. Fish and chips or a simple pasta dish (~$12–18 USD per person)

day_by_day.notes: Underwater photography requires patience and slow, non-disruptive movement around marine life. Never touch or chase marine animals for photos. The beach bonfire must be arranged in advance with the resort – confirm whether it is permitted on the beach and what the setup cost includes. Budget tip: buy souvenirs directly from local artisans rather than resort gift shops – quality is often higher and prices significantly lower.

day_by_day.morning: Final major snorkeling excursion – book a shared group trip to the best nearby snorkeling site you haven't yet visited, such as a manta ray point, whale shark aggregation area (seasonal), or a particularly vibrant coral garden. This is your last big underwater adventure, so make it count. Depart early for the best conditions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend a reflective afternoon on the beach. Begin mentally preparing for the end of the trip. Review your photos and videos from the entire trip. Take a final long swim in the lagoon. Visit the resort's beach boutique for any last-minute souvenir shopping – compare prices and choose wisely.
day_by_day.evening: Pre-farewell romantic dinner – choose the resort's best dining venue for a special evening. This is your second-to-last full evening in the Maldives, so make it memorable. Order something you haven't tried yet – perhaps a Maldivian tasting menu or a fresh whole grilled fish. Enjoy a long, leisurely dinner with meaningful conversation.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before the morning excursion – toast, fruit, and coffee (~$5–8 USD)
meals.lunch: On-boat or post-excursion beach café lunch – grilled fish sandwich or local short eats (~$8–12 USD)
meals.dinner: Resort's signature restaurant – splurge slightly for this special evening. Fresh seafood platter for two with tropical sides and a shared dessert (~$35–50 USD for two people). This is your most indulgent meal of the trip – well deserved.

day_by_day.notes: Whale shark and manta ray sightings are seasonal and cannot be guaranteed – check with local operators about current sightings. The best manta ray season in the Maldives is generally May–November, so March sightings are possible but not guaranteed. Budget tip: this is a good day to use up any remaining local currency (MVR) on food and small purchases before converting back.

day_by_day.morning: Last full morning in the Maldives. Wake up early for one final sunrise on the beach – sit together and watch the sky transform from deep purple to gold over the Indian Ocean. Take a final swim in the house reef – say goodbye to your favourite coral formations and fish. Collect any seashells (only already-empty shells found on the beach – never take live creatures or coral).
day_by_day.afternoon: Check-out formalities if required, or simply enjoy a final relaxed afternoon. Take a farewell walk around the entire resort island perimeter if accessible. Visit the resort's front desk to express gratitude and collect any departure information. Pack carefully and ensure all snorkel gear (if rented) is returned. Take final photos of the beachfront room and resort.
day_by_day.evening: Final dinner in the Maldives – make it special but budget-conscious. Choose your favourite meal from the trip and recreate the experience at the resort. Alternatively, visit a local island one final time for a truly authentic Maldivian farewell dinner at a local café. After dinner, sit on the beach for a final hour of stargazing and ocean sounds.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast – enjoy every last bite. If breakfast is included in your package, take full advantage (~$0 or $10–15 USD if not included)
meals.lunch: Light farewell lunch at the resort beach café – keep it simple with fresh tropical fruit, a cold drink, and a light sandwich (~$10–12 USD)
meals.dinner: Final Maldives dinner – your choice of resort restaurant or local island café. Celebrate 12 incredible days with your favourite dish of the trip. Budget ~$20–30 USD per person for a satisfying farewell meal.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your departure transfer arrangements for Day 13 – ensure the resort has your flight details and that a transfer is booked (public ferry to Malé + airport transfer or speedboat depending on your resort's location). Budget tip: settle your resort bill today to avoid any last-minute surprises and ensure you have enough cash/card funds for airport expenses.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise if time permits before departure. Complete packing and check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Take the arranged transfer back to Velana International Airport in Malé. Allow plenty of time for the journey – transfers can take 20 minutes to several hours depending on your island's location. Arrive at the airport with at least 2–3 hours before your departure flight.
day_by_day.afternoon: Airport departure procedures – check in, clear immigration, and proceed to the departure lounge. Browse the duty-free shops for any last-minute gifts (local Maldivian products, honey, or coffee are good budget-friendly options). Reflect on 13 extraordinary days in one of the world's most beautiful destinations.
day_by_day.evening: Board your departure flight. Carry beautiful memories, incredible underwater photos, and the deep relaxation that only the Maldives can provide. The honeymoon or romantic trip of a lifetime is complete.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast before departure or a grab-and-go option from the resort café (~$5–10 USD). Eat a proper meal as airport food is expensive.
meals.lunch: Airport café or lounge – budget ~$10–15 USD for a light airport meal. Alternatively, bring snacks from the resort or local market for the journey.
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or at your connecting airport. Budget accordingly based on your flight duration and airline meal inclusion.

day_by_day.notes: DEPARTURE DAY CHECKLIST: Confirm transfer booking the night before. Return all rented equipment. Settle the resort bill. Keep travel documents accessible. Carry Maldivian Rufiyaa (MVR) for any last-minute ferry or tip expenses. Note: MVR cannot be easily exchanged outside the Maldives – spend remaining local currency before departure. TRIP BUDGET SUMMARY: Accommodation (13 nights beachfront) – pre-booked; Daily food budget ~$25–40 USD/day for two; Excursions (dolphin watching, sandbank, snorkeling trips) ~$150–200 USD total; Transfers (public ferries + airport) ~$20–40 USD total; Souvenirs and incidentals ~$50–80 USD. Estimated total trip spend (excluding flights and accommodation): $500–700 USD for two people over 13 days.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport, Malé at 13:00. Complete immigration and customs. Meet resort transfer representative and board speedboat or seaplane transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in to your Beachfront accommodation, freshen up, and take a leisurely stroll along the resort beach to get acquainted with your surroundings.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from the beachfront. Enjoy a welcome cocktail at the resort's beach bar. Head to the resort's main restaurant for a romantic welcome dinner by the ocean.

meals.breakfast: Meal on the flight
meals.lunch: Light snack or meal at Velana Airport before/after arrival — try the airport café for a quick bite
meals.dinner: Welcome dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort's main restaurant — opt for the set menu featuring fresh Maldivian seafood and local curry dishes (mid-range resort dining)

day_by_day.notes: Confirm speedboat or seaplane transfer timing with the resort in advance. Keep travel documents handy for immigration. The resort check-in process may include a welcome drink and orientation briefing. Unpack lightly and rest — you have 12 wonderful days ahead!

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort. After breakfast, head to the resort's house reef for a guided introductory snorkeling session. Explore the colorful coral formations and spot reef fish, sea turtles, and rays directly accessible from the beach — perfect for warming up your snorkeling skills.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join the Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef excursion — one of the Maldives' most iconic reefs. Snorkel among parrotfish, moray eels, Napoleon wrasse, and vibrant coral gardens. The boat trip takes approximately 30–45 minutes from the resort. Spend 2–3 hours exploring the reef before returning.
day_by_day.evening: Relax on the beachfront with a tropical cocktail as the sun sets. Enjoy a romantic candlelit dinner on the beach arranged by the resort — request a private table setup for a honeymoon touch.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant — fresh tropical fruits, eggs, pastries, and Maldivian short eats
meals.lunch: Pack a light snack box from the resort for the Banana Reef trip, or enjoy lunch at the resort upon return — grilled fish sandwich and fresh juice at the beach café
meals.dinner: Candlelit beachfront dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort — choose from the à la carte menu featuring grilled lobster, tuna steak, or vegetarian options

day_by_day.notes: Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a rash guard, and an underwater camera for the Banana Reef excursion. Book the snorkeling trip the evening before through the resort's activities desk. Banana Reef is best visited in the morning or early afternoon for optimal visibility and calmer seas.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a slow, romantic morning. Have breakfast in bed or at a private table by the ocean. Spend the morning lounging on your beachfront terrace, reading, or taking a gentle swim in the crystal-clear lagoon in front of the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in the Underwater Spa Treatment for Two — a couples' spa ritual inside the resort's stunning glass-walled underwater treatment room. Watch colorful fish swim past as you enjoy massages, scrubs, and aromatherapy treatments together. This is one of the most unique and romantic experiences in the Maldives.
day_by_day.evening: After the spa, enjoy a refreshing swim or simply relax on the beach. As evening falls, head to the resort's overwater bar for sunset cocktails. Dine at the resort's specialty seafood restaurant for a more elevated dinner experience.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast in bed — request the resort's in-room dining option for a romantic touch with fresh fruit platters, eggs, and coffee
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's beach café — fresh salads, grilled fish tacos, and iced coconut water
meals.dinner: Specialty seafood dinner at the resort's overwater restaurant — fresh catch of the day, prawn curry, and a shared dessert platter

day_by_day.notes: Book the Underwater Spa Treatment well in advance — ideally at check-in — as slots fill up quickly, especially for couples. The treatment typically lasts 90–120 minutes. Avoid heavy meals before the spa session. Ask the spa for any add-ons like flower petal baths or champagne pairings for an extra romantic touch.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise yoga session on the beach — check with the resort activities desk for scheduled group or private sessions. After yoga, enjoy breakfast and then rent kayaks or stand-up paddleboards from the resort's water sports center to explore the lagoon at your own pace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a half-day dolphin watching cruise organized by the resort. Spinner dolphins are commonly spotted in the Maldives, often swimming alongside the boat. The cruise typically departs in the late afternoon and includes snorkeling stops at a nearby reef along the way.
day_by_day.evening: Return from the cruise in time to freshen up. Enjoy the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditionally decorated Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered just for the two of you. Sip champagne as the sky turns golden and pink — an unmissable honeymoon moment.

meals.breakfast: Healthy breakfast at the resort — açaí bowls, granola, tropical fruits, and herbal teas
meals.lunch: Casual lunch at the resort's beach shack — fish burgers, sweet potato fries, and fresh lime soda
meals.dinner: Dinner on the dhoni boat if the cruise package includes it, or return to the resort for a romantic dinner at the main restaurant — try the Maldivian fish curry with roshi bread

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne must be pre-booked through the resort's concierge. Confirm the exact departure time based on sunset (around 18:15–18:30 in March). Bring a light wrap or shawl for the evening breeze on the boat. Dolphin watching is weather-dependent — check conditions with the resort.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a relaxed morning at the resort. After breakfast, explore the resort's own coral reef restoration project if available — many Maldivian resorts offer guided tours of their coral nurseries, which is both educational and inspiring for snorkel enthusiasts.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on the Malé Cultural Walking Tour & Local Market Visit. Take the resort's speedboat transfer to Malé (approximately 20–40 minutes depending on resort location). A local guide will lead you through the historic Friday Mosque, the National Museum, Hukuru Miskiy, and the vibrant local fish and produce markets. Immerse yourself in authentic Maldivian culture.
day_by_day.evening: Before returning to the resort, stop at a local café in Malé for traditional Maldivian tea time (hedhikaa) — try short eats like bajiya (fish pastry), gulha (fish dumplings), and keemia. Return to the resort by speedboat and enjoy a quiet evening strolling the beach under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast — eggs Benedict, fresh juices, and Maldivian mas huni (tuna and coconut) with flatbread
meals.lunch: Local lunch in Malé during the cultural tour — visit a local restaurant for a traditional rice and curry meal with fish, dhal, and coconut sambol (very affordable, under $10 per person)
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort's beach bar — wood-fired pizza, fresh salads, and mocktails or local soft drinks

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly for the Malé cultural tour — cover shoulders and knees when visiting mosques and cultural sites. The fish market is busiest in the morning and late afternoon. Bring some local currency (Maldivian Rufiyaa) or USD for small purchases at the market. The tour typically lasts 3–4 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a free, unhurried morning. Sleep in, have a slow breakfast, and spend time on your beachfront terrace listening to the waves. This is a perfect day to simply enjoy the luxury of doing nothing — read a book, nap in a hammock, or take a long swim in the lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the resort's swimming pool area for a relaxed afternoon. Many mid-range Maldivian resorts have infinity pools overlooking the ocean — enjoy the pool, order tropical cocktails, and soak in the views. In the late afternoon, try a beginner's scuba diving discovery dive if offered by the resort's dive center.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a special honeymoon dinner arranged by the resort — request a private setup on the jetty or beach with fairy lights, flower arrangements, and a personalized menu. Toast to your trip with a bottle of sparkling wine.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely breakfast at the resort — fresh pastries, smoked salmon, fruit platters, and specialty coffees
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch — club sandwiches, Caesar salad, and fresh coconut water served at your sun lounger
meals.dinner: Private honeymoon dinner on the jetty — a curated 3-course set menu by the resort's chef featuring local seafood and international favorites, with a complimentary dessert

day_by_day.notes: Speak to the resort concierge at least 24–48 hours in advance to arrange the private honeymoon dinner setup. Many resorts offer complimentary romantic touches for honeymooners — don't hesitate to mention it's your honeymoon at check-in. The discovery dive is weather and availability dependent.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for a sunrise snorkeling session at the resort's house reef — the early morning light creates magical visibility underwater. Look for sea turtles, which are most active at dawn. After snorkeling, enjoy a hearty breakfast to refuel.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a guided manta ray or whale shark snorkeling excursion offered by the resort (seasonal — March is typically a good time for manta rays in the Maldives). These gentle giants are an awe-inspiring sight and an unmissable highlight of any Maldives trip. The excursion typically lasts 3–4 hours.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and relax with a sunset swim in the lagoon. Enjoy dinner at the resort's main restaurant and celebrate the halfway point of your trip with a dessert upgrade — try the Maldivian coconut cake or banana flambé.

meals.breakfast: Post-snorkeling power breakfast — eggs any style, whole grain toast, fresh fruit, and a protein smoothie
meals.lunch: Light lunch on the excursion boat — sandwiches and snacks provided, or a quick meal at the resort café upon return
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main restaurant — try the mixed seafood platter for two, with a shared dessert to celebrate the midpoint of your honeymoon

day_by_day.notes: Manta ray sightings are not guaranteed but March is within the North Malé Atoll manta season. Ask the resort dive center about recent sightings. Always maintain a respectful distance from marine life and never touch or chase manta rays or whale sharks. Reef-safe sunscreen is essential.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a relaxed morning with breakfast and a slow walk along the beach. Visit the resort's boutique or gift shop to browse locally made crafts, lacquerware, and Maldivian souvenirs. Spend time in the resort's garden or Zen area for quiet reflection.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on the Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience — be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the Indian Ocean. A private table is set up with a gourmet picnic spread, fresh seafood, chilled drinks, and a personalized romantic atmosphere. Snorkel around the sandbank's surrounding reef and enjoy the surreal isolation.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort in the late afternoon, sun-kissed and blissful. Enjoy a relaxing shower and rest before heading out for a casual evening at the resort's overwater bar. Watch the stars emerge over the ocean — the Maldives offers some of the clearest night skies in the world.

meals.breakfast: Tropical breakfast at the resort — fresh papaya, mango, coconut pancakes, and Maldivian tea
meals.lunch: Gourmet picnic on the sandbank — included in the Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience (chilled champagne, fresh lobster, tropical fruits, and artisan sandwiches)
meals.dinner: Light dinner at the resort's overwater bar — tapas-style sharing plates, sushi rolls, and a mocktail or cocktail of your choice

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sandbank Picnic must be booked in advance through the resort concierge. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and sunglasses — there is very little shade on an open sandbank. The experience typically lasts 3–4 hours. Weather permitting, this is one of the most romantic and memorable experiences of the entire trip.

day_by_day.morning: Take a morning fishing trip with the resort — traditional Maldivian line fishing (handline fishing) is a fun and authentic experience. Try your luck catching reef fish at dawn, and the resort's kitchen may even cook your catch for you later.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the resort's spa for individual treatments. Choose from a menu of massages, facials, and body scrubs using local ingredients like coconut oil, sea salt, and tropical flowers. Enjoy the spa's relaxation lounge, steam room, and herbal teas afterward.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic evening walk along the beach as bioluminescent plankton may light up the shoreline (seasonal phenomenon — check with the resort). Dine at the resort's specialty restaurant for a themed dinner night (many resorts host themed evenings like Maldivian night or BBQ night).

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the fishing trip — fresh fruit, yogurt, and coffee
meals.lunch: Resort lunch featuring your morning catch prepared by the chef — grilled reef fish with coconut rice and salad
meals.dinner: Themed dinner night at the resort (e.g., Maldivian Cultural Night) — local dishes like garudhiya soup, tuna curry, and traditional sweets, often accompanied by cultural performances

day_by_day.notes: Ask the resort about the bioluminescent plankton phenomenon — it is most visible on dark, calm nights away from artificial light. The fishing trip is usually an early morning activity departing around 06:00–07:00. Confirm spa bookings at least a day in advance to secure preferred time slots.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a free morning to revisit your favorite spots at the resort. Go for a final snorkel at the house reef, take underwater photos, or simply float in the lagoon and soak in the beauty of your surroundings. Have a leisurely breakfast with no rush.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a guided island-hopping excursion to a nearby local inhabited island (many resorts offer this). Visit a traditional Maldivian village, observe local life, see how boats are built, and interact with friendly locals. This provides a meaningful cultural contrast to the resort bubble.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and enjoy a couples' sunset yoga or meditation session on the beach if offered. Dine at the resort's main restaurant for a relaxed, familiar dinner and reminisce about your favorite moments from the trip so far.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort — enjoy all your favorites one more time
meals.lunch: Lunch on the local island during the island-hopping excursion — try a local teashop for rice and curry or fresh roshi with tuna
meals.dinner: Comfort dinner at the resort's main restaurant — choose your favorite dishes from the week, paired with a glass of wine or tropical juice

day_by_day.notes: Dress respectfully when visiting local inhabited islands — cover shoulders and knees. Purchasing locally made crafts and products directly from residents supports the local economy. Ask your guide about the history and traditions of the island you visit. Sunset yoga sessions should be booked with the resort's wellness team.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up for one last sunrise snorkeling adventure at the house reef. Spend extra time underwater, photographing the coral and fish that have become familiar friends over the past week. After snorkeling, enjoy a relaxed breakfast and reflect on your favorite underwater memories.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend a leisurely afternoon at the resort's infinity pool or beach. Indulge in a final couples' massage at the spa (book in advance). Browse the resort boutique for last-minute souvenirs — look for handcrafted lacquerware, woven mats, and locally made jewelry.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne if you wish to repeat this magical experience, or opt for a quiet sunset walk along the beach. Have a special farewell dinner at the resort's finest restaurant — splurge slightly on this last full evening.

meals.breakfast: Special breakfast on your beachfront terrace — request in-room dining for a romantic final morning meal
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch — light and refreshing options like ceviche, fresh salads, and tropical smoothies
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at the resort's premium restaurant — splurge on the tasting menu or chef's special, with a bottle of wine to celebrate your honeymoon

day_by_day.notes: Begin packing non-essential items this evening to make departure day smoother. Confirm your checkout time and departure transfer details with the resort concierge. If you have any pending spa or activity bookings, ensure they are settled. Take a final walk on the beach at night to stargaze one last time.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a final slow breakfast at the resort. Take one last swim in the lagoon and say goodbye to the house reef. Spend the morning capturing final photos and videos of the resort, beach, and ocean to treasure forever.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of the resort (standard checkout is typically 12:00 — confirm with the front desk). If your departure transfer allows, request a late checkout or use the resort's day-use facilities (pool and beach) until your transfer time. Board your speedboat or seaplane transfer back to Velana International Airport, Malé.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive in Malé with time to explore the airport's duty-free shops for last-minute gifts — Maldivian honey, local spices, and handicrafts make great souvenirs. Relax at the airport lounge if available before your onward flight.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — savor every bite of the tropical spread one last time
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort before checkout, or a meal at the Velana Airport restaurant upon arrival in Malé
meals.dinner: Airport dining or in-flight meal depending on your departure schedule

day_by_day.notes: Reconfirm your flight details and transfer timing the night before. Allow extra time at the airport for check-in and security. Maldives departure tax is typically included in your flight ticket. Keep a small amount of Maldivian Rufiyaa or USD for any last-minute purchases. Ensure all resort bills are settled before departure.

day_by_day.morning: Travel day — depending on your flight schedule, you may be in transit or arriving at your home destination. Use this time to rest, reflect on your incredible 13-day Maldives honeymoon, and begin organizing your favorite photos and memories.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue travel or arrive home. If you have a long layover in a connecting city, take the opportunity to explore the airport or nearby area briefly before your final flight.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive home safely. Unpack your treasured souvenirs, upload your photos, and begin planning your next adventure together — the Maldives will always be waiting to welcome you back.

meals.breakfast: In-flight meal or airport café breakfast
meals.lunch: In-flight meal or layover airport dining
meals.dinner: Home-cooked meal or your favorite local restaurant to welcome yourselves back

day_by_day.notes: This is a buffer/travel day to account for long-haul flights back home. Keep all travel documents, boarding passes, and receipts organized. If you purchased travel insurance, retain all documentation. Consider writing a review of Aegean Bliss Resort to help future travelers. Welcome home — and congratulations on your honeymoon!

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for two. Watch the sun melt into the horizon while sipping champagne and enjoying a curated platter of local and international canapés. A quintessential romantic experience perfect for honeymooners seeking intimacy and breathtaking natural beauty.

experiences.name: Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef
experiences.description: Explore one of the Maldives' most iconic and vibrant coral reefs, teeming with parrotfish, moray eels, sea turtles, and colorful reef sharks. Guided snorkeling sessions ensure you discover the best spots while learning about the marine ecosystem. Crystal-clear visibility and calm waters make this an unforgettable underwater adventure for couples.

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' spa ritual inside a stunning glass-walled underwater treatment room, surrounded by the gentle movement of tropical fish and coral gardens. Choose from signature massages, body wraps, and aromatherapy treatments designed to rejuvenate and deepen your romantic connection in an utterly unique luxury setting.
experiences.location: Huvafen Fushi Resort, North Malé Atoll

experiences.name: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience
experiences.description: Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the ocean for an exclusive private dining setup. A personal butler and chef serve a freshly prepared Maldivian and seafood feast with chilled wine, surrounded by nothing but white sand and endless blue water — the ultimate honeymoon memory.

experiences.name: Malé Cultural Walking Tour & Local Market Visit
experiences.description: Discover the vibrant culture and heritage of the Maldivian capital with a guided walking tour through the historic streets of Malé. Visit the 17th-century Hukuru Miskiy coral stone mosque, the National Museum, and the bustling local fish market where fishermen bring in their daily catch. Sample traditional Maldivian street snacks like hedhikaa and sip on sweet black tea at a local café.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight LH arrives at 13:00. Relax onboard and prepare for arrival.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Malé International Airport at 13:00. Meet your dedicated Aegean Bliss Resort butler at the arrivals hall for a seamless VIP transfer via private speedboat to the resort. Upon arrival, enjoy a traditional Maldivian welcome with chilled coconut water and flower garlands. Check into your Beachfront villa, unpack, and take a leisurely stroll along your private stretch of beach to soak in the surroundings.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into the resort with a relaxed sunset cocktail hour on your villa's private deck overlooking the Indian Ocean. Head to the resort's signature overwater fine-dining restaurant for a romantic welcome dinner.

meals.breakfast: Onboard flight
meals.lunch: Light refreshments provided during private speedboat transfer arranged by the resort
meals.dinner: Welcome dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort's signature overwater restaurant — à la carte menu featuring fresh Maldivian lobster, grilled catch of the day, and a curated wine pairing from the sommelier

day_by_day.notes: Inform the resort in advance of your arrival time so the butler and speedboat transfer are ready. Request a chilled bottle of champagne in the villa upon arrival as a honeymoon surprise. No strenuous activities on Day 1 — focus on relaxation and acclimatization.

day_by_day.morning: Begin your first full day with a lavish in-villa breakfast delivered by your personal butler, served on your private beachfront terrace as the sun rises over the turquoise lagoon. After breakfast, take a guided resort house reef snorkeling session with a marine biologist — explore the colorful coral gardens just steps from your beach, spotting reef sharks, sea turtles, and vibrant tropical fish.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the resort's overwater spa for a couples' rejuvenation session — choose from a signature Maldivian coconut scrub and massage duo. Afterward, relax by the infinity pool with tropical fruit platters and chilled drinks served poolside by attentive staff.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditionally decorated Maldivian dhoni, privately chartered just for the two of you. Watch the sun dip below the horizon with a glass of vintage champagne in hand, accompanied by canapés and soft Maldivian music.

meals.breakfast: In-villa butler breakfast — tropical fruit, freshly baked pastries, eggs prepared to order, fresh juices, and Maldivian black tea or specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Poolside dining at the resort's beach club — grilled seafood skewers, fresh salads, and coconut-based Maldivian curries
meals.dinner: Return from the dhoni cruise and dine at the resort's beach grill restaurant — candlelit table on the sand, freshly grilled mahi-mahi, lobster thermidor, and a bottle of premier cru Burgundy

day_by_day.notes: Book the Sunset Dhoni Cruise at least 24 hours in advance through your butler. The cruise typically lasts 1.5–2 hours. Bring a light wrap for the evening sea breeze. This is an ideal evening for a honeymoon toast.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise yoga session on the beach or your villa deck, arranged privately by the resort's wellness team. Follow with a nutritious spa breakfast at the wellness pavilion featuring acai bowls, cold-pressed juices, and herbal infusions. Then embark on the Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef excursion — one of the Maldives' most iconic dive sites, teeming with parrotfish, moray eels, Napoleon wrasse, and stunning coral formations.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from Banana Reef and enjoy a leisurely afternoon. Explore the resort's water sports center — try stand-up paddleboarding or kayaking around the lagoon at your own pace. Later, indulge in a private couple's hammam ritual at the spa.
day_by_day.evening: Dine at the resort's Japanese-Maldivian fusion restaurant — an intimate, low-lit space with floor-to-ceiling ocean views. Savor fresh sashimi, wagyu beef tataki, and a signature Maldivian-Japanese tasting menu.

meals.breakfast: Wellness breakfast at the spa pavilion — acai bowls, granola with Maldivian honey, cold-pressed tropical juices, and herbal teas
meals.lunch: Light beachside lunch after snorkeling — fresh ceviche, prawn cocktail, and chilled sparkling water or a glass of rosé
meals.dinner: Japanese-Maldivian fusion tasting menu at the resort's specialty restaurant — 7-course meal with sake and wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: Banana Reef is typically accessed by a short speedboat ride. Snorkeling equipment is provided; the resort's marine guide will accompany you. Apply reef-safe sunscreen only. Confirm spa appointments the evening prior.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow, indulgent morning entirely at leisure. Have a champagne breakfast in bed, ordered through your villa butler. Spend the morning reading on your private sun deck or wading in the warm, shallow lagoon just outside your beachfront villa.
day_by_day.afternoon: Experience the Underwater Spa Treatment for Two — one of the most extraordinary spa experiences in the world. Indulge in a couples' ritual inside a stunning glass-walled underwater treatment room, surrounded by the mesmerizing marine life of the Indian Ocean. Choose from a deep-tissue couples' massage, aromatherapy ritual, or the resort's signature ocean-inspired body treatment.
day_by_day.evening: Private in-villa romantic dinner set up by your butler on the beach directly in front of your villa. Dine under a canopy of stars with tiki torches, rose petals, and a personalized menu crafted by the resort's executive chef — a true honeymoon highlight.

meals.breakfast: Champagne breakfast in bed — freshly squeezed juices, croissants, smoked salmon, eggs benedict, seasonal tropical fruits, and a bottle of Moët & Chandon
meals.lunch: Casual lunch at the resort's beachside café — club sandwiches, grilled reef fish tacos, and fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Private beachfront in-villa dinner — personalized 5-course menu with options such as chilled gazpacho, seared scallops, prime beef tenderloin, and a decadent chocolate fondant dessert with champagne

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Spa Treatment must be booked well in advance as it is the resort's most sought-after experience. Coordinate with your butler for the private beach dinner setup — request special touches like a message in the sand or floating flower arrangements for a honeymoon surprise.

day_by_day.morning: Join a guided sunrise dolphin watching cruise — depart at dawn by speedboat to spot spinner dolphins leaping through the golden morning light. Return to the resort for a full resort buffet breakfast at the main restaurant, offering an extraordinary spread of international and Maldivian specialties.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's marine center for a private introduction to freediving with a certified instructor. Glide effortlessly beneath the surface and experience the reef in a completely new way. Afterward, relax at the overwater bar with signature cocktails and panoramic lagoon views.
day_by_day.evening: Attend the resort's weekly Maldivian cultural night — featuring traditional bodu beru drumming performances, local crafts, and a themed buffet dinner showcasing authentic Maldivian cuisine including mas huni, garudhiya fish soup, and hedhikaa snacks.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the main restaurant — live cooking stations, fresh pastries, tropical fruits, Maldivian dishes, and international favorites
meals.lunch: Overwater bar lunch — gourmet burgers, fresh crab salad, truffle fries, and signature cocktails
meals.dinner: Maldivian cultural night themed buffet — authentic local dishes, seafood BBQ stations, and tropical dessert spread

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin watching is weather-dependent; the resort will advise if conditions are unfavorable and offer rescheduling. The cultural night is a wonderful opportunity to connect with local heritage — dress in smart-casual resort wear.

day_by_day.morning: Spend the morning on a private snorkeling tour of the resort's surrounding reefs with a dedicated marine biologist guide. Discover lesser-visited coral gardens, spot eagle rays, and learn about the Maldives' extraordinary marine ecosystem. Return to the villa for a refreshing outdoor shower and light rest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on the Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience — be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the Indian Ocean. A gourmet picnic table is set up just for the two of you with chilled champagne, fresh seafood platters, artisan cheeses, and decadent desserts, all surrounded by nothing but turquoise water and endless sky.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort in the late afternoon. Enjoy a couples' sunset cocktail hour at the overwater bar before a relaxed dinner at the resort's Mediterranean-inspired restaurant.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast on the terrace — continental spread with fresh fruits, yogurt, granola, pastries, and specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Private sandbank picnic — gourmet hamper with chilled champagne, fresh lobster, sashimi, artisan breads, tropical fruit, and chocolate truffles
meals.dinner: Mediterranean restaurant at the resort — burrata, fresh pasta with seafood, wood-fired branzino, and a curated Italian wine list

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank picnic is weather and tide dependent. Your butler will confirm the exact timing the morning of. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and light cover-up as there is no shade on the sandbank. This is a quintessential Maldives honeymoon experience — consider requesting a special cake or personalized message for an anniversary or honeymoon celebration.

day_by_day.morning: Full rest and leisure morning — sleep in, enjoy a late in-villa breakfast, and spend time in the villa's private plunge pool. This is your halfway point — take the day at a gentle pace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's dive center for a beginner's scuba experience in the resort's protected lagoon, guided by a PADI-certified instructor. Even without prior experience, you'll get a taste of the underwater world in a safe, controlled environment. Follow with a relaxing session in the resort's steam room and sauna.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the resort's rooftop sky bar for pre-dinner cocktails as the stars begin to emerge. Then enjoy a specially arranged stargazing experience with the resort's resident astronomer — identify constellations of the Southern Hemisphere through a high-powered telescope on the beach.

meals.breakfast: Late in-villa brunch — eggs royale, smoked salmon bagels, granola parfait, fresh juices, and mimosas
meals.lunch: Pool bar snacks — lobster rolls, truffle popcorn, fresh fruit skewers, and sparkling water
meals.dinner: Rooftop sky bar dinner — premium sushi and sashimi platters, wagyu beef skewers, and a curated Japanese whisky and sake selection

day_by_day.notes: The stargazing experience is best on clear nights — confirm with the resort concierge by late afternoon. The scuba lagoon experience is ideal for non-divers and requires no prior certification. A perfect mid-trip rejuvenation day.

day_by_day.morning: Take a morning excursion to Malé for the Cultural Walking Tour & Local Market Visit — discover the vibrant culture and heritage of the Maldivian capital with an expert guide. Explore the historic Friday Mosque (Hukuru Miskiy), the National Museum, and the colorful local fish market. Browse local handicrafts and pick up handmade lacquerware or woven mats as souvenirs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by early afternoon. Spend the afternoon at leisure — lounge on the beach with a good book, take a nap in your villa's daybed, or enjoy a soothing solo spa treatment such as a hot stone massage or reflexology session.
day_by_day.evening: Dine at the resort's premier fine-dining restaurant for a special romantic dinner — choose a private table on the jetty extending over the lagoon for an unparalleled setting. Enjoy a chef's tasting menu with wine pairing.

meals.breakfast: Early buffet breakfast at the main restaurant before the Malé excursion
meals.lunch: Authentic Maldivian lunch at a local restaurant in Malé recommended by your guide — try mas riha (fish curry), roshi flatbread, and fresh reef fish dishes
meals.dinner: Jetty fine-dining experience — 8-course chef's tasting menu featuring Maldivian-inspired haute cuisine with optional premium wine or champagne pairing

day_by_day.notes: The Malé tour typically involves a 20–30 minute speedboat transfer. Dress modestly when visiting the mosque (shoulders and knees covered). The local fish market is most vibrant in the early morning but remains active through midday. Keep some local currency (Maldivian Rufiyaa) for small market purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a private sunrise fishing excursion on a traditional dhoni — try your hand at traditional Maldivian hand-line fishing in the early morning calm. Any catch can be brought back to the resort's chef to be prepared as a custom lunch dish.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the resort's beach club — relax on premium sunbeds with personalized service, enjoy fresh tropical juices and chilled towels, and take a refreshing dip in the warm Indian Ocean. Optional: book a private jet ski or parasailing experience through the resort's water sports center.
day_by_day.evening: Couples' private cooking class with the resort's executive chef — learn to prepare traditional Maldivian dishes such as mas huni, tuna curry, and coconut-based desserts. Afterward, enjoy the meal you've prepared together on your villa terrace.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before the fishing excursion — fresh fruit, yogurt, and coffee served by your butler
meals.lunch: Custom lunch at the resort's kitchen using your morning catch — chef-prepared grilled fish with Maldivian spices, coconut rice, and fresh salad
meals.dinner: Private cooking class dinner on your villa terrace — dishes prepared during the class, paired with a bottle of fine wine selected by the sommelier

day_by_day.notes: Fishing excursions depart very early (around 05:30–06:00) to catch the best conditions. Confirm with your butler the night before. The cooking class is a wonderful interactive honeymoon experience — inform the chef of any dietary restrictions or allergies in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Indulge in a full morning spa journey at the resort's overwater spa — begin with a couple's body scrub using Maldivian sea salt and coconut, followed by a full-body hot stone massage, and conclude with a facial treatment. Take your time — this is a 3-hour immersive wellness experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the spa, enjoy a leisurely afternoon swim in your private villa plunge pool. Have a gourmet afternoon tea delivered to your villa — finger sandwiches, scones with clotted cream, macarons, and a fine tea or champagne selection.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the resort's beach for a private bonfire experience arranged by your butler — roast marshmallows, sip aged rum cocktails, and enjoy the sound of the waves under a starlit sky. A guitarist can be arranged to serenade you.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast before the spa — light and nourishing with fresh fruits, overnight oats, green juices, and herbal teas
meals.lunch: Gourmet afternoon tea in-villa — assorted finger sandwiches, warm scones, petit fours, macarons, and your choice of fine tea or champagne
meals.dinner: Casual private bonfire dinner on the beach — a curated BBQ spread delivered by your butler including grilled lobster, premium cuts, roasted vegetables, and a dessert of toasted s'mores

day_by_day.notes: Pre-book the full spa journey at least 48 hours in advance. Request the private bonfire setup through your butler by early afternoon. The guitarist serenade is available upon request at an additional cost — a beautiful touch for a honeymoon evening.

day_by_day.morning: Take a full-day excursion to a nearby local island to experience authentic Maldivian village life — visit a traditional community, observe local craftspeople at work, and explore the island's lush interior. Your resort guide will accompany you to ensure a respectful and enriching cultural experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the local island excursion — visit the island's beach, snorkel in the surrounding reef, and enjoy a picnic lunch on the shore before returning to the resort by late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and freshen up. Celebrate your penultimate full day with a special dinner at the resort's champagne and caviar lounge — an ultra-exclusive experience featuring Beluga caviar service, fine champagne, and premium bites in an intimate, luxurious setting.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast before departure — full buffet spread at the main restaurant
meals.lunch: Gourmet picnic lunch on the local island shore — artisan sandwiches, fresh fruit, local Maldivian snacks, and chilled beverages prepared by the resort
meals.dinner: Champagne and caviar lounge — Beluga caviar with traditional accompaniments, blinis, fine cheeses, and a curated selection of vintage champagnes

day_by_day.notes: The local island excursion requires modest dress (shoulders and knees covered) out of respect for local customs. Your resort guide will brief you beforehand. The caviar lounge is a premium add-on — reserve in advance through your butler as seating is extremely limited.

day_by_day.morning: Your last full day — begin with a sunrise swim in the Indian Ocean directly from your beachfront villa. Have a slow, indulgent in-villa breakfast as you reflect on the trip. Spend the morning snorkeling the resort's house reef one final time, soaking in the beauty of the underwater world.
day_by_day.afternoon: Afternoon at complete leisure — enjoy every last moment of your beachfront villa. Take photos, collect memories, and spend quality time together on the beach. Optional: book a final couples' massage at the spa as a farewell treat.
day_by_day.evening: Grand farewell dinner at the resort's most prestigious restaurant — request a special honeymoon setup with floral arrangements, personalized menus, and a dedicated waiter. Celebrate your extraordinary Maldivian journey with a bottle of vintage champagne and a custom dessert created by the pastry chef.

meals.breakfast: Ultimate in-villa farewell breakfast — lobster eggs benedict, smoked salmon, fresh tropical fruits, pastries, fresh juices, and a bottle of Moët & Chandon rosé
meals.lunch: Beachside casual lunch — fresh grilled fish, salads, and chilled rosé wine on the sand
meals.dinner: Grand farewell dinner — personalized 6-course tasting menu with champagne and wine pairing, custom honeymoon dessert, and a keepsake personalized menu card

day_by_day.notes: Ask your butler to arrange a special farewell gift or memory — many resorts offer a custom photo book, a message in a bottle, or a framed underwater photo from your snorkeling sessions as a honeymoon keepsake. Pack non-essentials this evening to make the morning departure smoother.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning — enjoy a last sunrise from your villa deck with coffee or tea. Have a light farewell breakfast before your butler assists with luggage and checkout formalities. Take a final walk along the beach to say goodbye to this paradise.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private speedboat transfer back to Malé International Airport, arranged and escorted by your resort butler. Arrive at the airport with ample time for check-in and departure. Enjoy the resort's exclusive airport lounge access (if available) while awaiting your flight.
day_by_day.evening: Departure — carry with you the memories of 13 extraordinary days in the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Light farewell in-villa breakfast — fresh fruits, yogurt, pastries, and your favorite coffee or tea
meals.lunch: Airport lounge dining or onboard flight
meals.dinner: Onboard flight

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your speedboat transfer time with your butler the night before — allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your scheduled flight for the transfer and check-in process. Settle any outstanding spa, excursion, or minibar charges the evening prior to avoid a rushed checkout. Tip your butler and key staff members as a gesture of appreciation for their exceptional service throughout your stay.
